280267300.description:
Esterbrook
Fountain Pen and Mechanical Pencil Set - Red Jewel Tone
Vintage, Mid-20th Century, 2 Pieces plus Box
This vintage Esterbrook writing set showcases the mid-century design of the iconic Camden, New Jersey manufacturer. Founded in 1858, Esterbrook was a leader in American stationery, legendary for its interchangeable nib system and reliable lever-fill mechanisms. This matched pair features a fountain pen and mechanical pencil in a vibrant pearlescent red finish, accented with signature silver-tone hardware.
Branded "Esterbrook" visible on clips and barrel markings
Includes 1 lever-filler fountain pen, 1 matching mechanical pencil, original box, and literature
Classic red pearlescent "jewel tone" finish
Original presentation box included
Condition:
Good vintage condition with noticeable surface wear consistent with age. Untested and sold as-is. The fountain pen lever shows resistance and the internal sac likely requires replacement for full utility. The original red presentation box shows shelf wear and minor structural damage to corners. Literature insert shows age-related yellowing.

You are purchasing a "Pair of White and Gray Stone Geode Bookends" in "Used" condition.
Add a bold, natural touch to your shelf or desk with this striking pair of stone geode bookends. Each piece features a polished crystal face with intricate white crystalline detail and gray banding around the edges, contrasted by a more rugged, natural outer side. These bookends are both functional and decorative—heavy enough to support your books while also working beautifully as display pieces on their own. The felt pads on the bottom help protect your furniture and keep the pieces stable. This listing includes two matching geode halves, forming one complete pair of bookends. Perfect for: - Adding a natural, earthy accent to your home or office - Displaying on a bookshelf, console table, or desk - Gifting to crystal, mineral, or geology enthusiasts Keywords: geode bookends, stone bookends, crystal bookends, natural stone decor, shelf decor, mineral display, white gray bookends, desk accessories, home office decor measures approx. 11x8.5x4
Condition Notes:
